short_description: Overview: Hello Watch 3 PLUS Gen 2 (2024 edition) is a feature-rich smartwatch that combines a 2.04-inch AMOLED full-screen display with OS10-style UI to deliver a smooth, modern wrist experience. Performance & Capacity: The high-resolution AMOLED panel...
description: Overview: Hello Watch 3 PLUS Gen 2 (2024 edition) is a feature-rich smartwatch that combines a 2.04-inch AMOLED full-screen display with OS10-style UI to deliver a smooth, modern wrist experience. Performance & Capacity: The high-resolution AMOLED panel with 60Hz refresh provides fluid animations and clear readability, while 1GB ROM supports responsive menu navigation, watch faces and core apps for everyday use. Technology / Features: Bluetooth calling, notification mirroring, music control, multiple watch faces and OS10-inspired layouts make it suitable for users who want smartphone-style interaction on the wrist without over-complexity. Ideal Usage Scenario: Designed for daily wear, office, commuting and light workouts, Hello Watch 3 PLUS Gen 2 tracks steps, heart rate, SpO₂ and sleep while also handling quick calls and alerts when paired with a compatible phone. Durability & Safety: An IP68 water-resistant design, magnetic charging and a battery rated for up to around 3 days of typical use help it fit into everyday routines when used within normal smartwatch conditions.
